record.question: Global Citizen Award -2014 was recently conferred by The Atlantic Council to
record.explanation: Answer D: Lee Kuan Yew. Lee Kuan Yew was one of the Atlantic Council's 2014 Global Citizen Award honorees. The organizer's original 2014 list includes him; the other printed persons were not that year's listed recipients. Reference: https://www.atlanticcouncil.org/events/flagship-event/global-citizen-awards/2014-honorees/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
